title: Mumbles 1888 brings together soccer fans from the Ozarks, United Kingdom - NewsBreak
text:
By Jesse Elliott ,
1 hours ago
SPRINGFIELD, MO — Mumbles 1888 brought fans together for the USA vs Bosnia and Herzegovina match on Wednesday, July 1.
This match is the first time since 2002 that the USA has made it to a knockout match in the World Cup. For this match, Mumbles 1888 was expecting a big turnout, and was able to use the outdoor space behind the pub.
General manager, Bailey Turner, said, “We know there’s people that are passionate about it here. So, it’s not really a surprise to us at all. We’re excited about it.”
Bailey also talked about the outdoor space, saying, “We have a viewing area we called the cage. We started opening it up for USA matches because we just get so busy, we needed extra space. So, our friends at Ace Hardware, Tim, let us use his space back there.”
Anthony Moist, a fan from the Ozarks, spoke about his appreciation for the soccer-themed pub, saying, “This is awesome. This is like everything you dream about coming to a sports bar. So, this is great”
Not only were soccer fans from the Ozarks at Mumbles, but also a fan from across the Atlantic Ocean. Oliver Jagroop, a fan from the United Kingdom, was also there to watch the game and talked about how he ended up in Springfield, Missouri, for the match.
Oliver said, “I started in Kentucky. I played soccer in college, and then I’m working here in the summer. and then somehow, I just started meeting these different people that like soccer, and we just ended up here.” Mentioning that the soccer-themed pub felt like home in a way.
USA won its match against Bosnia and Herzegovina. In the USA’s next match, they will take on Belgium on Monday, July 6, at 7 p.m.
